info.name: Cart Actions Endpoints Catalog Connector Jobs API

items.docs:
Use this endpoint to start an internal job to export products from Catalog Connector. 
Specify the `formatType` query parameter to export data in either CSV or JSONL format. In the request body, provide the `ids` of all products to be exported, the product type, and the locale.

params.name: ids
params.description:
The 24-character system-generated file ID created using the [Create a File](/v3/api-reference/catalog-connector/files/create-file) endpoint.

Depending on the type of IDs, the array represents the file IDs or job IDs. Specify up to 15 IDs separated by commas. Note the following limitations of using this parameter:
  - This parameter can't be combined with any other parameters. 
  - Pagination isn't supported when this parameter is specified.

params.name: type
params.description: Specify the type of operation or job performed when the file was uploaded.

params.name: inputFileIds
params.description: The file IDs specified in the request. You can specify up to 15 file IDs separated by commas. - This parameter can only be combined with the query parameter `lastJobOnly`. - Pagination isn't supported when this is specified.

params.name: lastJobOnly
params.description: A flag indicating whether the response should be based only on the last job. Set it to `true` to show response based on the last job and `false` to include response based on all jobs that meet the criteria. This is only applicable with `type` and `inputFileIds`.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of records to skip before returning records. For example, with an offset of 20 and limit of 10, the system returns records from 21 to 30.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of records per page.

items.docs:
Use this endpoint to retrieve a paginated list of import and export jobs related to Catalog Connector.
The following constraints apply when using the query parameters:
  - The query parameter job `ids` can't be combined with any other query parameters.
  - The query parameter `inputFileIds` can only be combined with the query parameter `lastJobOnly`. 
  - Pagination isn't supported when `ids` or `inputFileIds` is specified.

Get a paginated list of jobs related to products and collections by specifying the request body. You need to specify the criteria for the search such as job `id`, `type`, `status`, `collectionId`, or `inputFileId`.
